title: Maternity Package Pay-in-Full Credit after the Enrollment Deposit
content:
**Q. Does paying the pre-delivery balance soon after the enrollment deposit earn a credit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package?**

Yes, under Good Faith & Price Estimates. The days since the enrollment deposit run from the posting date of the latest initial deposit collection on the maternity estimate to today's date, the posting date not counted and today counted. A pre-delivery balance paid zero to seven days after it takes off one and a half percent (1.5 percent) of the delivery package price; eight to thirty days after takes off one half of one percent (0.5 percent); later, with no enrollment deposit on record, or with one dated after today's date, takes off nothing. The delivery package price is the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version.

| Days since the latest initial deposit collection | Credit taken off |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 1.5 percent of the delivery package price |
| 8 to 30 | 0.5 percent of the delivery package price |
| 31 or more | nothing |
| none on record, or posted after today | nothing |

**Q. Edges?** (hypothetical, delivery package price 10000.00) 7 days, 150.00 off; 8 days, 50.00 off; 30 days, 50.00 off; 31 days, nothing.
